atoms.a: Some students in Sage's class have the opportunity to study whatever they want, while her parents can’t afford to provide her with a good education.
Mike works at a warehouse for eight hours a day, moves heavy boxes and gets paid minimum wage. His job has low prestige according to his role in society.
Jayden doesn't have much money. Instead of seeing her struggles, her classmates attach negative labels to her and think her poverty is her own fault.
Madison believes that if her friends would just work as hard as she does, they could all become as successful no matter their social background.
Alexander grew up in a rich family in London that has held a title for generations. He has higher chances of getting good education and a well-paid job.
Isla and Noah are cleaning the streets every day. Even though their job is essential for the city, people usually look down on them.
The Morgan family lives in a gated luxury flat with a private entrance, while other families in the same neighbourhood live in small, cheap flats.
